// diagnostic E0204

Jet.UseWhileWriteActive

Same value used while a write parameter holds it in one call

What

Same value used while a write parameter holds it in one call

Why

While something is being changed through a write parameter, nobody else may be looking at it

Fix

Pass the value only once, or pass a copy of it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UseWhileWriteActive: Tests/UI/borrow_conflict.stderr.

Error: Jet.UseWhileWriteActive: `x` is being changed in this call, so it can't be used again here
  --> Tests/UI/borrow_conflict.jet:5:13
    |
  5 |     both(x, x)
    |             ^
 Why: While something is being changed through a write parameter, nobody else may be looking at it
 Fix: Pass `x` only once, or copy first with `x.copy()`
